title: Can I BEAT Racing Kings Chess?
summary: Racing Kings: both kings race to the 8th rank; giving check is illegal. He walks his king up with a knight bodyguard and wins three games (two by resignation).
rules: No player may give check (moves that check are illegal), so kings cannot be captured.
First king to reach rank 8 wins (if White arrives first, Black gets one more move to also arrive for a draw - standard rule, not discussed).
Racing Kings start: all pieces on ranks 1-2, no pawns.
current_impl_issues: Matches base Racing Kings; ensure check-giving moves are illegal and the draw rule.

current_impl.explain: No checks allowed. Race your king to the top rank first to win.
